notes.criteria: eq_all_bins_3dB = fraction of ALL grid bins with |10log10(H_s/H_o)| < 3 dB (headline metric); eq_noise_truncated_3dB = same condition restricted to bins where AT LEAST ONE modality exceeds its estimated noise floor (difference-field median); eq_intersection_3dB = restricted to bins where BOTH modalities exceed their estimated noise floors
notes.finding: neither truncation removes the non-monotone noise dependence, because the difference-field noise-floor estimate itself is transfer-dependent at low noise (the difference field is dominated by signal attenuation, not noise) and because very low optical noise leaves stylus-dominated high-frequency bins unmatched; the equivalence fraction is therefore an operational, estimator-dependent diagnostic, and noise optimisation should use the monotone RMSE ranking instead
